classification: Exact-source complete four-profile Go/LLGo CI and package coverage pass. Hosted elapsed comparison, contribution integration and controlled acceptance remain open.

plan.mechanism: Extend bounded loop interference to uncached copies and reuse a resident group member home. Preserve unique entry live-ins, complete frame words, all cold PCs, vector aliases and polling; no new physical register or ABI change.
plan.qualification: Local complete codegen tests under Go and LLGo release; full existing four-profile CI supplies remaining package semantics, race, no-cgo and coverage gates.
plan.performance: One unchanged five-group source comparison against the immediately preceding event. No flags, ISA, alignment, reference pins or sampling changes; preserve all adverse and unresolved results. Static compilation and runner checks are not timing acceptance.

localQualification.scope: One complete affected codegen package on macOS arm64; all models execute when applicable. Full four-profile CI remains required, not inferred.
